name: SPT-CL J0307-6225, northern field (Hubble)
blurb: SPT-CL J0307-6225, a merging galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: bcgnorth-hubble
story: Two galaxy clusters are colliding in SPT-CL J0307-6225, and this field frames the brightest galaxy of the northern one. Hubble mapped the unseen dark matter here, using the crash as a natural collider to test whether dark matter interacts with itself.

claims.text: SPT-CL J0307-6225 is a major merging galaxy cluster of two colliding structures, 0307-6225N and 0307-6225S
The Hubble target BCG-NORTH is a galaxy (and gravitational lens) in the cluster; the tile was set to cover it
Hubble imaging maps the dark matter distribution to constrain self-interacting dark matter, using merging clusters as dark matter colliders
